text: みえない　ところ　でも　ホントは　なにか　おちてたり　する！

structure.jp: みえない　ところ　でも
structure.en: even in places you can't see

structure.jp: なにか　おちてたり　する！

patterns.name: 〜たり
patterns.explanation: たり with する says something happens now and then, as one example of what can happen. おちてたり　する = 'something is sometimes lying there'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing describes that thing. みえない　ところ = 'places you can't see'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: で 'in' plus も gives 'even in'. ところ　でも = 'even in places'.
